_about: Offline eval set for LLM-assisted moderation (node ace moderation:llm-eval). Each case is the context the classifier would get for an escalated message. expected: 'allow' (an ordinary message - auto-allow is correct), 'not_allow' (a person should see it - review or block are both correct), 'block' (a clear violation). categories: what a correct verdict should name. Grow this from moderators' resolved cases.
